content.text: You hearing anything about 3 reps getting fired related to the masks thing?
No
I’ll try to find out more
Ok let me know I’ll ask around
Your story may get a lot easier
Loved “Your story may get a lot easier ”
Text that Reginald you quoted if you still have his info
Did you hear that he was one of them or just because he was on the shifts
Yea I heard he was one but I got very little info. Only received one text about it so far
Ok
Just wanted to know because of the approach
Might be tough to get anything out of them if they got a severance
This guy was a young guy
Yea but they may give him a month pay or something just to keep his mouth shut
I texted him
He said he was one
Wow. Did he say why?
No i just asked him
Kinda hoping to hear what their explanation was

Just bad timing for everything, and one mistake that came when I’m sure they were looking to cut down staff whenever possible. But it’s all good, there’s no hard feelings with it, just an unfortunate situation
Wat
Don’t pass that on
Had to do with the mask-making process
Never mind
Three of them were drinking beer in the company parking lot?
I dunno
That’s garbage. We drank beer in the company lots almost monthly
We had organized parties before Lions games, etc

Someone finally answered me and I guess you’re right... 3 inside sales reps were having beers after their shift in the parking lot (of the mask factory). Not during lunch but after they were done working. An Ilitch exec drove by and saw them and asked for their badge numbers. They were suspended for 2 days and then fired Monday. This is completely outside the normal culture. It was very normal for Tigers employees to drink in the parking lot after work. How they could fire them without any warning I have no idea. They aren’t factory workers! How would they know that isn’t ok?
